payout_quote: To receive the $325 bonus: you must use your bonus offer code when opening a new Wells Fargo consumer checking account, which is subject to approval, by January 12, 2027 and receive $1,000 or more in qualifying electronic deposits within 90 calendar days of account opening (the 'qualification period'). Once you have met all requirements, we will deposit the bonus into your new account within 30 calendar days. The Wells Fargo Everyday Checking account monthly service fee is $15. The monthly service fee can be avoided with one of the following each fee period: $1,500 minimum daily balance; $5,000 or more in qualifying deposit balances, investment balances, or both; $500 or more in total qualifying electronic deposits; a primary account owner who is 17 to 24 years old. (Official Wells Fargo offer page, re-loaded 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus deposited into the new checking account within 30 days after the 90-day qualification period ends
eligibility: New Wells Fargo consumer checking customers only; primary account owner; no Wells Fargo consumer checking bonus in the past 12 months; not a Wells Fargo employee; US person (no W-8 filers); account subject to approval
steps: Open a new Wells Fargo Everyday Checking account online using the bonus offer code
Set up direct deposit (paycheck, government benefits) totaling $1,000+ within 90 days of opening
Make sure deposits are qualifying: ACH direct deposit, RTP/FedNow instant payments, or debit-card-network credits - NOT Zelle, mobile deposits, branch/ATM deposits, or account-to-account transfers
Wait for the 90-day qualification period to end; the $325 bonus posts within 30 days
catches: $15 monthly service fee on Everyday Checking unless you keep a $1,500 minimum daily balance, receive $500+/month in qualifying electronic deposits, or are 17-24 - route $500+/month of direct deposits through the account so the fee never eats the bonus
NOT eligible if you received any Wells Fargo consumer checking bonus in the past 12 months
Zelle, mobile check deposits, cash deposits and transfers between your own accounts do NOT count toward the $1,000 - only real direct deposits and qualifying electronic credits
The bonus is taxable interest income - Wells Fargo will send a 1099-INT
You must remember to use the bonus offer code at opening; without it there is no bonus
biggest_catch: The $1,000 must be real qualifying electronic deposits - Zelle, mobile deposits and moving your own money between accounts don't count - and a $15 monthly fee applies unless you keep a $1,500 balance or route $500+/month in qualifying deposits.
